name: ServoEdge
summary: YZ-ServoEdge is a servo motor development board for three-phase BLDC/PMSM control, with an integrated three-phase power stage, HPM6E8Y control hardware, encoder/Hall feedback and EtherCAT IN/OUT. It supports robot-motion and industrial-control development; protocol capabilities depend on matching firmware and hardware revision.

description.en: YZ-ServoEdge is a servo motor development board for three-phase BLDC/PMSM control, with an integrated three-phase power stage, HPM6E8Y control hardware, encoder/Hall feedback and EtherCAT IN/OUT. It supports robot-motion and industrial-control development; protocol capabilities depend on matching firmware and hardware revision.
